Kayla M.: Hey team — just unboxed my setup. Monitor and USB-C dock arrived but dock isn't powering monitors. Also when I try guest wifi (for onboarding laptop) the browser shows cert error. Who should I loop in?

mike-it: Welcome Kayla! Can you check the dock LED? Also paste the dock model/serial (on the underside) and your laptop model. If it's a Dell WD19-like the power brick might be missing.

Kayla M.: LED is off. Model says 'BrandX ProDock 4P' serial S/N: PX12345. Laptop is MacBook Pro M2.

marco-ops: Looks like support ticket 38271 shipped with everything, but packing note shows 'AC adapter separate box' — can you check under peripherals box? Sometimes the brick is taped in there.

Kayla M.: Checked — no brick. There's a small power cable but no brick. :grimacing: 

mike-it: OK please run this quick check from terminal to confirm USB devices:
```
system_profiler SPUSBDataType | grep -i dock -A3
```
If nothing shows, we'll treat it as no-power and swap the dock. I'll open a ticket.

mike-it: Filed IT ticket IT-2026 with priority P2 and requested same-day ship for adapter. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-2026 — @marco-ops can you confirm spare adapter availability?

marco-ops: We have one spare in the SF office. I'll arrange courier. ETA 1 business day. :truck: 

Kayla M.: Amazing, thanks. Any tips for the guest wifi cert while I'm waiting for adapter? Right now the onboarding laptop can't join corp wifi, so I'm using tethering.

mike-it: Guest Wi-Fi is intended for contractors; new hire corp cert requires MDM. For now keep tethering. Once you have the adapter connected, book a 15-min onboarding with us and we'll enroll your machine in Jamf and push corp certs. Schedule link: https://cal.example.com/it-onboard

Kayla M.: Scheduling now. Thank you both! :raised_hands: 

it-bot: Shipment update: IT-2026 adapter marked 'out for delivery' by SF courier. Tracking: https://trk.example/courier/9898

Kayla M.: Got the adapter this morning — dock and monitors powered, laptop enrolled in Jamf during the onboarding session. All set. Closing the loop.

mike-it: Great, marking IT-2026 resolved. Welcome aboard, Kayla! :tada:
